label: upcoming copy of the letter f
explanation: Fires when the letter f is about to be (re)produced. In the delimiter/copy phase it fires at essentially every step whose output is f (rate 99.8%) and ramps up over the 1-2 steps before f is output; it decays over the steps after. When f is the first original token, it also fires through the late original phase (t>=3) and at <DEL>. This gives the strongest activations (max at the step outputting f when the sequence starts f f f). Activation is lower when f is further away. Weaker, lower-rate activity also shows up for other upcoming outputs (n, p, z, c ~20-30% rate), and there is diffuse low-magnitude firing in sequences with no f (about 18% of mass). Never fires at t=0,1. Dev: precision 0.81, recall 0.44, mass recall 0.60.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=f (+6.67), phase=2 & out_tok=f (+5.12), next_out=f (+5.04), orig0=f (+4.71), out_tok=f (+4.55), orig1=f (+3.65). Lower it: prev2_tok=- (-6.07), out_tok=2 (-6.07), out_tok=w (-5.74), out_tok=t (-5.45).
